existing_equivalents.finding: DecisionContextExpansionRequest is a frozen CanonicalContract. It names a parent decision/context/completeness witness, a named unresolved question, an expansion-tier ContextReference, and a four-limit budget. expand_decision_context binds the exact parent, admits only the original-closure handle and question, intersects token/byte/count/latency ceilings, rejects repeated equivalent_request_id hashes and omitted prior_request_ids, and emits a delta retry capsule rather than a full replay. This is the selected ExpansionRequest authority. The identifier SemanticProjectionExpansionRequest@1 remains unregistered and absent from nested source.
existing_equivalents.reuse_decision: Select this schema as SemanticProjectionExpansionRequest@1. Do not fork a second request record in datasets proof_context.

existing_equivalents.finding: EvidenceExpansionRequest is a smaller question-plus-reference-ids progressive-disclosure type. It requires at least one reference ID. It has no parent witness, budget, equivalent-request hash, or CIDv1 schema marker.
existing_equivalents.reuse_decision: Reuse as a companion for evidence-value paging. Do not promote it to SemanticProjectionExpansionRequest@1.

existing_equivalents.system: Accelerator context completeness witness and expansion-tier handle
existing_equivalents.finding: ContextCompletenessWitness lists expansion_reference_ids. ContextReference at tier expansion carries referenced_content_id, repository_id, tree_id, and metadata including unresolved_questions. The selected request must use that handle; a forged or evidence-tier handle fails closed.
existing_equivalents.reuse_decision: Reuse as the admitted missing-fact handle and parent completeness binding. Do not treat the witness as the request.

existing_equivalents.finding: evaluate_context_sufficiency emits a CID-bound ContextSufficiencyClaim. Opaque critical dependencies, missing proof/test/schema/fixture/config, budget truncation, unresolved invalidation, and low confidence force expansion_required. A verification pass is never sole sufficiency authority. This names why expansion is required; it is not the accelerator request that names the missing handle, affected decision, and token ceiling.
existing_equivalents.reuse_decision: Reuse as datasets-owned insufficiency evidence. Do not relocate ExpansionRequest into sufficiency.py.

existing_equivalents.finding: ContextPackRecord.expansion_required is true when sufficiency_state is not sufficient. require_sufficient raises InsufficientContextError for expansion-required packs. proof_context exposes no ExpansionRequest type.
existing_equivalents.reuse_decision: Leave proof_context unchanged. ExpansionRequest remains the accelerator decision-context request.
